name: B10-0389/2025 (PPE) – Detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on five Greek Cypriot citizens from the Republic of Cyprus who were detained in July 2025 by the Turkish military in the occupied north of Cyprus while visiting land they own. The Parliament calls their detention unlawful and politically motivated, says their health is at risk, and demands they be freed immediately and without conditions. It also asks the European Commission and the EU's diplomatic service to push for their release.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. Parliament demands the immediate release of the five detainees.
- **Who it affects:** The five EU citizens held in the occupied areas of Cyprus.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions, the UN, and the Turkish government as diplomatic pressure.
